state: 32 nibbles; nibble 0 is the rightmost hexadecimal digit; bit 4*i+b is bit b of nibble i with b=0 the LSB
permutation_semantics: After the S-box layer flatten v as v[4*i+b]. Before key/constant addition set p[j] = v[P128[j]].
round_transition: For r=0..16, next S-box input difference equals p at all bit positions because XOR with a shared key/constant cancels in differences. At bit b=1 or b=2 of each nibble, an independent round-key value bit may affect the two concrete executions but the same bit is used in both; at b=0 and b=3 there is no key addition.
round_constant_relaxation: At each round, the value XORed at every listed constant position is an independent free Boolean shared by the two executions. At all other positions no constant is injected.
relaxation: Each key-addition bit and each listed constant bit in every round is independent. This is a superset of the real key schedule and fixed constants, so UNSAT remains an authoritative impossibility proof.
trail_file_format: Ignoring comments and blank lines, lines 2*r and 2*r+1 are the input and output nibble differences of round r.
